	SUBTOTAL_CENTS,
	TAX_PAID_CENTS,
	ORDER_TOTAL_CENTS,
	SUBTOTAL,
	TAX_PAID,
	ORDER_TOTAL,
	ORDERED_AT
) as (
    with

source as (

    select * from CDO_DEMO_DB.raw.raw_orders

),

renamed as (

    select

        ----------  ids

        subtotal as subtotal_cents,

        order_total as order_total_cents,

)
